bibl.title: Una nuova testimonianza su Alcmane in P.Oxy. XXIX 2506, fr. 131?
bibl.seg: Stefano Vecchiato, Una nuova testimonianza su Alcmane in P.Oxy. XXIX 2506, fr. 131?
bibl.note: A closer scrutiny of P. Oxy. XXIX, 2506 (= MP3 1950; LDAB 193), fr. 131, l. 1, reveals the traces to be compatible with the name of Alcman, who is quoted another four times in this very papyrus.
